proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10875.2 *lakkuṭa explicitly gives Hindi lakṛī “stick, firewood” and Gujarati lākṛī. Bundeli lakaḍiya is the regional feminine/plural firewood form; this corrects the older unsplit lakuṭa assignment to the k-retaining subsection. Joint comparison: H lakaḍiya “firewood” matches reviewed bundeli_atarra lakaḍiya “firewood” (f_zian7i6bb3fvo). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13161 saptāha means a period of seven days and gives Nepali sātā “week”. Rajasthani sapta/sapto preserve learned pt with regional final adaptation; this family link leaves learned or neighboring Indo-Aryan transmission open. Joint comparison: H sapta “week” matches reviewed had saptā “week” (f_rf3isi4lccmes). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
